title: Wayfare Pro Status, Length of Service and Insurance Binder Acceptance Days
content:
For insurance binders recorded on **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreements, a long-serving Wayfare driver with a high Wayfare Pro status receives more binder acceptance days, the calendar days from the recording day for which the binder is accepted as the auto insurance on file. The Pro status is the one held on the driver's earnings account under the **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** product.

**Clause.** A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Gold, Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond or Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite and whose agreement has been active at least 1095 calendar days since its activation date adds 8 days to the binder acceptance days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Silver whose agreement has been active at least 1095 days adds 4 days; any other driver adds none.

Days active are counted in calendar days from the activation date on the agreement to the recording day.

**Combinations of the two conditions.**

| Pro status on the earnings account | Agreement active 1095 days or more | Agreement active 1094 days or fewer |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite | adds 8 | adds 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | adds 4 | adds 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | adds 0 | adds 0 |

Both parts of the condition must hold: a Diamond driver active 1000 days adds nothing, and so does a Blue driver active 2000 days.

**Hypothetical boundary.** Recording day 2026-07-01. An agreement activated on 2023-07-02 has been active 1095 days; with Wayfare Pro Gold it adds 8. Activated on 2023-07-03 it has been active 1094 days and adds nothing, whatever the status.
